description: This course covers the fundamentals of digital incident handling and response, including incident classification using ISO/IEC 27035, digital forensics with tools like EnCase and FTK, and network traffic analysis using Wireshark. Students will learn to apply the NIST Cybersecurity Framework for incident response planning, implement the MITRE ATT&CK framework for threat detection, and perform log analysis with Splunk and ELK stack. Topics include malware analysis using YARA rules and static analysis techniques, data loss prevention (DLP) strategies with Symantec and McAfee, and incident response playbooks for ISO/IEC 27035 compliance. The course also explores cloud incident response in AWS and Azure, automated response with SOAR platforms, and post-incident analysis using the NIST IR Framework. Specific algorithms like the Bloom filter for anomaly detection, and standards such as ISO/IEC 27032 for IoT security are included.
